description: Background Windows desktop for AI agents: native GUI automation, screenshots and app testing.
notes: Anode needs 64-bit Windows 10/11 Pro, Enterprise or Education (or Windows Server with an RDP host).
Check prerequisites, then enable child sessions once; setup asks for administrator approval:
Register Anode with the Codex and Claude Code CLIs found on PATH:
Before 'scoop update anode', save work in the seat, run 'anode quit' (it closes every seat application) and close MCP clients using Anode; Scoop refuses to update while Anode processes run.
##: PATH entry instead of bin: Scoop's shim frees its console before starting a GUI-subsystem exe, which leaves anode.exe no console to attach for CLI output.
